semiconductor_relevance: High — GfG specializes in gas detection systems that are crucial for maintaining safety and compliance in semiconductor manufacturing environments.

Their D-ReX Series offers modular, high-performance fixed gas detection systems capable of monitoring over 60 gases, making them essential for semiconductor facilities.
